power-systems.title: Uninterruptible Power Supply Systems (AC & DC)
power-systems.shortDesc: Assembly, routine maintenance, and complete retrofits of industrial DC power systems and UPS units. Battery capacity testing and cell conductance/resistance analysis.
power-systems.fullDesc: We engineer, deploy, and service professional uninterruptible power systems for critical telecommunications and infrastructure facilities. Our comprehensive lifecycle support covers battery bank replacements, controlled discharge capacity testing, and complete modernizations of legacy telecom power plants.
scopeList: Deployment and commissioning of industrial DC power plants (-48V DC)
Comprehensive retrofits of existing power cabinets and switchgear
Battery bank replacements in modular cabinets and heavy-duty racks
Advanced battery health diagnostics: controlled load discharge and internal resistance tests
Periodic technical inspections and preventive maintenance for critical UPS systems
power-systems.specifications: 48V DC / 230V / 400V AC systems; Professional measurement test reports
power-systems.targetSector: Cellular base stations, telecom transmission nodes, server rooms, and broadcast facilities

reactive-power.title: Reactive Power Compensation Systems
reactive-power.shortDesc: Engineering, assembly, and modernization of automatic capacitor banks and detuned reactor cabinets. Elimination of penalties for inductive and capacitive reactive energy.
reactive-power.fullDesc: We deliver end-to-end solutions to minimize industrial electricity costs through power factor correction. We perform power network quality audits, engineer detuned capacitor steps, and prefabricate automated compensation cabinets with microprocessor controllers.
scopeList: Assembly and installation of reactive power compensation cabinets
Installation of heavy-duty capacitor banks and detuned harmonic filters
Programming and commissioning of digital automatic reactive power controllers
Power quality audits, power factor (cos φ) measurements, and harmonic distortion analysis
Routine servicing and replacement of aged capacitor switching contactors
reactive-power.specifications: Capacitor banks with detuned filter reactors; Overcurrent & thermal protection; Automatic microprocessor controller
reactive-power.targetSector: Technical infrastructure nodes, transmission stations, and industrial manufacturing plants

freecooling-hvac.title: FreeCooling Ventilation & Precision Air Conditioning
freecooling-hvac.shortDesc: Energy-efficient FreeCooling systems and precision climate control. Assembly, maintenance, and F-gas compliance across Poland and Germany.
freecooling-hvac.fullDesc: We deploy specialized thermal management systems maintaining optimal temperature and humidity for mission-critical hardware. We serve commercial and industrial clients across Poland and Germany.
scopeList: Installation and commissioning of precision climate control cooling units
Installation of FreeCooling modular ventilation systems and control units
Mounting of weather-resistant air intake louvers on technical containers and facades
Certified refrigerant leak detection and system performance audits (F-gas compliant)
freecooling-hvac.specifications: Precision cooling units; Variable speed EC electronically commutated fans; Integrated F7/G4 cassette filtration
freecooling-hvac.targetSector: Telecommunication containers, server rooms, optical fiber nodes, and data centers

telecom-containers.title: Technological Containers & Technical Raised Floors
telecom-containers.shortDesc: Complete technological outfitting of access node telecom containers. Installation of technical flooring, cable tray containment, lighting, and 19" rack cabinets.
telecom-containers.fullDesc: We carry out comprehensive turn-key fit-outs for telecommunication shelters and modular server hubs. Work includes high-load technical raised flooring, 19" server rack suites, overhead and underfloor cable tray containment, equipotential bonding, and environmental monitoring.
scopeList: Design and construction of modular heavy-load raised access floors and access platforms
Installation of 19" server and distribution racks, ceiling-suspended and underfloor cable baskets
Backup power cabling, internal LED technological illumination, and emergency escape lighting
Equipotential bonding grounding bar (GSW) and earthing network connectivity
Access control, environmental telemetry sensors, and automated fire detection systems
telecom-containers.specifications: Heavy-load modular floor panels; Structural galvanized steel support frames;
telecom-containers.targetSector: Access nodes, containerized telecom stations, modular server rooms

switchboards.title: Switchboard Prefabrication & Certified Inspection Protocols
switchboards.shortDesc: Custom engineering and prefabrication of LV distribution boards, ATS cabinets, and outdoor weather-rated switchgear. Complete electrical verification and test reports.
switchboards.fullDesc: We prefabricate modern low-voltage switchboards based on components from leading European manufacturers. Prior to dispatch, each enclosure undergoes rigorous functional testing, dielectric property verification, and electrical parameter measurements, concluded with a routine test report in accordance with EN 61439 and a CE Declaration of Conformity.
scopeList: Prefabrication of main low-voltage power distribution switchboards and control cabinets
Assembly of facility distribution panels and weather-rated outdoor weatherproof cabinets
Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS) emergency power changeover systems
Insulation resistance, fault loop impedance, and protective bonding continuity testing
Preparation of complete as-built documentation, routine inspection and acceptance test reports, and CE Declaration of Conformity
switchboards.specifications: Ingress protection up to IP65; Certified modular & compact switchgear; Compliance with IEC/EN 61439
switchboards.targetSector: Transmission sites, industrial automation cabinets, and infrastructure power distribution

facility-maintenance.title: Technical Facility Maintenance & 24/7 Operations
facility-maintenance.shortDesc: Comprehensive lifecycle technical management for critical infrastructure: backup power, HVAC systems, structural inspections, and perimeter facility maintenance.
facility-maintenance.fullDesc: We guarantee operational uptime for distributed technical assets. Our engineering team conducts preventive maintenance cycles, oversees cooling and power systems, and responds rapidly to field incidents under strict SLA agreements.
scopeList: Scheduled preventive maintenance of electrical installations and climate control systems
Operational oversight and load-testing of diesel generators and UPS units
Structural and thermal envelope condition audits of technical containers and shelters
Maintenance of adjacent grounds, fencing, and landscaping
Urgent emergency response to technical faults
facility-maintenance.specifications: High-readiness technical availability; Dedicated SLA procedures; Full digital inspection reporting
facility-maintenance.targetSector: Distributed cellular towers, broadcast retransmission sites, and unstaffed technical nodes

industrial-lines.title: Industrial Installations & Production Line Relocation
industrial-lines.shortDesc: Electrical installation, machinery cabling for automated manufacturing lines, and professional decommissioning, transport, and equipment relocation.
industrial-lines.fullDesc: We provide specialized electromechanical installation services for industrial and manufacturing plants. Our scope includes machine cabling, high-capacity cable containment, control cabinet hookups, and precise relocation of production lines.
scopeList: Power and signal cabling for automated machinery and manufacturing lines
Erection of heavy-duty industrial cable containment, ladders, and support channels
Safe electrical decommissioning, labeling, and preparation of machinery for transport
Connection of industrial motors, drives, sensors, and automation panels
Post-assembly electrical verification and technical support during line commissioning
industrial-lines.specifications: Heavy-duty industrial cable containment; Machine power supply up to 1000V; Compliance with Machinery Directive
industrial-lines.targetSector: Manufacturing plants, automated factories, processing halls, and industrial facilities

about.title: A Reliable Partner in Critical Infrastructure
about.credoSub: There are only engineering challenges that require knowledge, determination, and uncompromising precision.
about.p1: Eminstall is a family-owned engineering company rooted in solid craftsmanship, extensive field experience, and uncompromising quality. We specialize in advanced electrical installations, custom switchboard prefabrication, AC/DC uninterruptible power systems, and precision cooling for industrial and high-reliability facilities.
about.p2: Our foundation is punctuality, accountability, and efficiency – we strictly adhere to schedules and take full personal ownership of every task. We emphasize transparent, direct client communication throughout every stage, backed by thorough, certified measurement and inspection protocols.
about.precisionDesc: We take care of every millimeter of the installation, eliminating faults before they even occur.
about.safetyDesc: We operate in strict accordance with the highest HSE standards and EU technical regulations.
about.engineeringControl: Two-stage engineering control over every single project.

services.title: Comprehensive Engineering Solutions
services.subtitle: We guarantee absolute professionalism at every phase of a telecom facility's lifecycle.
services.serv1Desc: Comprehensive build, modernization, maintenance, and periodic technical audits of telecom containers. Following each audit, we issue a professional, detailed inspection report complete with diagnostic data and electrical measurements.
services.serv2Desc: Installation, professional servicing, and detailed inspections of cooling systems – including highly specialized precision climate systems. We guarantee stable temperature and humidity levels, safeguarding critical electronics.
services.serv3Desc: Installation and maintenance of fail-safe UPS systems and backup generators. We secure critical facilities against sudden voltage fluctuations and power grid blackouts.
services.serv4Desc: Prefabrication, assembly, and integration of dedicated electrical distribution and automation cabinets. We build exclusively using certified, high-grade components from renowned brands like Hager, Socomec, and Vertiv.

whyUs.title: The Foundation We Build Trust Upon
whyUs.point1Desc: As a family business, we take full personal responsibility for every project. Our name is our absolute pledge of integrity.
whyUs.point2Desc: Our technical team holds full industry certifications, specialized electrical permits (SEP), and extensive telecom experience.
whyUs.point3Desc: We know that every minute of network downtime means commercial losses. We are structured to mobilize and react instantly.
whyUs.point4Desc: We understand the regulatory specifics of both Polish and German markets. All works satisfy local and European standards.
whyUs.projectsDesc: We have successfully completed power supply and cooling system upgrades for major telecom hubs in both Poland and Germany. We specialize in works at sites requiring maximum security and zero downtime. Our custom-prefabricated electrical distribution cabinets reliably power transmission systems, while our preventative container maintenance services eliminate unplanned downtime for our corporate clients.
whyUs.realizationsSubtitle: Explore some of our professional engineering achievements on telecom sites.
whyUs.realization1Desc: Complete thermal insulation upgrade, rewiring, and external mechanical structure maintenance.
whyUs.realization2Desc: Installation of specialized Vertiv precision cooling units integrated with automatic alert systems.
whyUs.realization3Desc: Deployment of modular UPS blocks and Automatic Transfer Switch (ATS) systems for base stations.
whyUs.realization3Stats: Modular UPS • ATS Systems • Emergency Generators
whyUs.realization4Desc: Design and assembly of custom electrical switchboards using certified components from Hager and Socomec.
whyUs.realization5Desc: We prepare detailed, professional inspection protocols for every technical review, including complete diagnosis, electrical measurements, and maintenance guidelines.
whyUs.realization5Stats: ISO Compliant • Full Technical Diagnostics • Electric Measurements
